name: comp-270
title: Error Bordered Alert
blurb: Bordered error alert with red icon.
description: Error alert with visible border using a red error icon. Provides more visual prominence than inline errors for section-level validation feedback.
use_when: Highlighting errors at the form section or page level. When borders provide needed visual hierarchy.
avoid_when: Minimal alert style preference. When borders conflict with existing layout design.
a11y: No ARIA alert role. Icon hidden from screen readers. Parent should add role='alert' and aria-live for accessibility.
